name: TDLM Title Case
author: Scott Weaver

sections.description:
TDLM Title Case adds a Title Case panel to the block editor document sidebar. When you’re editing a post title, choose one of four options in a 2×2 button grid:

  1. Title Case — capitalize words using configurable lowercase and uppercase word lists
  2. All Lowercase
  3. All Uppercase
  4. cRaZy CaSe

The title updates immediately and supports undo through the editor.

Configure the lowercase and uppercase word lists under Settings → TDLM Title Case.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the tdlm-title-case folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the TDLM Title Case plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Edit a post in the block editor and open the Title Case panel in the document sidebar
  4. Optionally configure word lists under Settings → TDLM Title Case
sections.faq:
Does this work with the Classic Editor?

No. Version 2.0.0 requires the block editor (Gutenberg). Classic Editor support was removed.

Can I customize which words stay lowercase in title case?

Yes. Go to Settings → TDLM Title Case and edit the comma-separated lowercase and uppercase word lists.
